description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kaluwarippuwa, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510072
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration, specifically the declaration of a determination regarding title to a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 0140, Block 08) under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land particulars including location, extent, owner information, and title class, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
